Observed evidence: 527 of 1,201 repeats followed a nonciting inspection.
Proposed reporting change: Separate first-inspection results from later records already collected.
Limits of the evidence: No four-visit requirement or benefit of longer follow-up was established.

Observed evidence: 538 repeats with S&S followed rapid closure.
Proposed reporting change: Keep later records even after rapid closure.
Limits of the evidence: Rapid closure was not shown to cause repeats.

Observed evidence: 179 of 900 repeats with S&S followed index records without S&S.
Proposed reporting change: Attach later classifications to the history, not only the index label.
Limits of the evidence: The results do not establish which index group merits priority.

Observed evidence: 215 episodes ended follow-up at an outside-sequence citation.
Proposed reporting change: Give other citations, missing records, and ambiguous links distinct status codes.
Limits of the evidence: Those citations do not meet the primary repeat rules.

Observed evidence: 326 episodes ended follow-up at an operator change.
Proposed reporting change: Keep mine history for handover but separate operating-spell results.
Limits of the evidence: Prior records do not establish successor performance or liability.

Observed evidence: Delayed shares ranged from 35.2% to 62.7% across provision groups.
Proposed reporting change: Report provision-specific counts and inspections beside pooled results.
Limits of the evidence: The pooled average is not a universal performance threshold.
